Former CBI Director Nageshwar Rao Launches Political Party

Former CBI Director M. Nageshwar Rao has entered active politics by launching the 'Sarvajan Sanatan Party' in Varanasi. Rao, who has nearly four decades of experience, stated that the nation's reconstruction will not be achieved through administrative reforms alone.
